title: Which engine owns the authenticated graph RPC?
question: The three-tier read needs an authenticated RPC to activate graph artifacts. The R9 register names graph-rs as the artifact owner but does not say whether serving-rs calls it directly or through the state engine's dispatch table.

options.label: serving-rs calls graph-rs directly
options.consequence: One fewer hop; serving holds a graph credential.

options.label: Route through the state engine dispatch table
options.consequence: Matches the R3 manifest; adds a typed row to contracts-rs.

thread.text: Does routing through state add a round trip on the hot path, or only at activation?
Only at activation. Reads use the activated lens in memory; the dispatch hop happens once per artifact generation.
Route through the state engine. Add the typed contracts-rs row in the same PR.

answer.text: Route through the state engine. Add the typed contracts-rs row in the same PR.
